stablecoins.name: USDC
stablecoins.backing: Cash + short-term US Treasuries
stablecoins.backingShort: cash and Treasuries
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Primary loan asset across all major curators
stablecoins.keyFact: Monthly attestations by Deloitte. Deepest liquidity of any stablecoin in DeFi lending.
stablecoins.regulation: Regulated by US state money transmitter licenses

stablecoins.name: USDT
stablecoins.backing: Cash, Treasuries, commercial paper, secured loans, Bitcoin, gold
stablecoins.backingShort: cash, Treasuries, commercial paper, and other assets
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Primary on L2s. Gauntlet absorbed $775M USDT supply during Stream crisis
stablecoins.keyFact: Largest stablecoin by market cap (~$184B). Quarterly attestations only (not full audits).
stablecoins.regulation: Not regulated by any major jurisdiction — ongoing controversy

stablecoins.name: DAI
stablecoins.backing: ETH, wBTC, RWAs at 150%+ collateral ratio
stablecoins.backingShort: overcollateralized crypto (ETH, wBTC, RWAs)
stablecoins.yieldSource: borrower interest via DAI Savings Rate
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Legacy positions, being phased out in favor of USDS
stablecoins.keyFact: Pioneer of overcollateralized stablecoins. Being replaced by USDS under Sky Protocol rebrand.

stablecoins.name: USDS
stablecoins.backing: ETH, RWAs, Treasuries — same engine as DAI but expanded
stablecoins.backingShort: crypto and real-world assets (same engine as DAI)
stablecoins.yieldSource: protocol revenue via Sky Savings Rate
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Growing — Sky curates its own Morpho vaults
stablecoins.keyFact: Replacement for DAI. Sky Protocol is the MakerDAO rebrand. Top 3 stablecoin by market cap.

stablecoins.name: sUSDS
stablecoins.backing: Staked USDS in Sky Savings Rate module
stablecoins.backingShort: staked USDS
stablecoins.yieldSource: borrower interest and RWA yield from Sky Protocol
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Used as collateral in Morpho markets
stablecoins.keyFact: Yield-bearing version of USDS. Redeemable for USDS plus accrued rewards anytime.

stablecoins.name: USDe
stablecoins.backing: ETH/BTC spot long + equal short perpetual futures
stablecoins.backingShort: delta-neutral derivatives position (spot + short futures)
stablecoins.yieldSource: perpetual funding rates + ETH staking rewards
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Very widely used as collateral. Spark allocated $1.1B to it
stablecoins.keyFact: Not backed by dollars at all — backed by a derivatives position. Funding rates can go negative in bear markets.

stablecoins.name: sUSDe
stablecoins.backing: Staked USDe
stablecoins.backingShort: staked USDe
stablecoins.yieldSource: perpetual futures funding rates + ETH staking rewards
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Popular collateral in Morpho and Aave markets
stablecoins.keyFact: Yield depends entirely on derivatives markets staying functional. Weekly yield distribution.

stablecoins.name: USD0
stablecoins.backing: 1:1 by tokenized T-Bills from BlackRock, Hashnote, Ondo, M0
stablecoins.backingShort: tokenized T-Bills from multiple institutional issuers
stablecoins.yieldSource: T-Bill yield distributed via staking
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Used in Morpho markets with 'unliquidable' market at 96.5% LLTV
stablecoins.keyFact: Backed by T-Bills but governance risk is real — Usual changed USD0++ redemption rules, causing a depeg in Jan 2025.

stablecoins.name: USD1
stablecoins.backing: Short-term Treasuries, USD deposits, cash equivalents
stablecoins.backingShort: Treasuries and cash (custodied by BitGo, managed by Fidelity)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Re7 curates a vault for it on Morpho
stablecoins.keyFact: Trump-linked stablecoin. Crossed $3B market cap. Solid Treasury backing but carries political/reputational risk.

stablecoins.name: USDY
stablecoins.backing: Short-term US Treasuries + bank demand deposits
stablecoins.backingShort: Treasuries and bank deposits
stablecoins.yieldSource: Treasury yield passed through to holders
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Used as collateral in DeFi lending. Ondo also backs Usual's USD0
stablecoins.keyFact: Ankura Trust acts as collateral agent — if Ondo defaults, Ankura liquidates to repay holders.
stablecoins.regulation: Licensed — Ankura Trust as verification/collateral agent

stablecoins.name: USDM
stablecoins.backing: T-Bills in segregated, bankruptcy-remote accounts
stablecoins.backingShort: T-Bills (segregated, bankruptcy-remote)
stablecoins.yieldSource: T-Bill yield via daily token rebasing
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Steakhouse curates the steakUSDM vault on Morpho
stablecoins.keyFact: Being sunset after Anchorage Digital acquisition (May 2025). Licensed by Bermuda Monetary Authority.

stablecoins.name: EURCV
stablecoins.backing: Euro reserves
stablecoins.backingShort: euro reserves (MiCA-compliant)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Steakhouse curates a Morpho vault for Safe with it
stablecoins.keyFact: First major MiCA-compliant EUR stablecoin. First non-USD institutional stablecoin in curator ecosystem.

stablecoins.name: GHO
stablecoins.backing: Minted against Aave V3 collateral (ETH, USDC, wBTC, etc.) at ~130%+
stablecoins.backingShort: overcollateralized positions on Aave V3
stablecoins.yield: Via stkGHO (launching 2026, ~8.4% APY, subject to slashing)
stablecoins.yieldSource: borrower interest payments (stkGHO stakers face slashing risk)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Aave-native. Not yet in Morpho vaults. Likely default stablecoin for Aave V4
stablecoins.keyFact: Aave's own stablecoin. stkGHO stakers earn ~8.4% APY but face slashing if protocol has a deficit.

stablecoins.name: PYUSD
stablecoins.backing: USD deposits, Treasuries, cash equivalents
stablecoins.backingShort: USD deposits and Treasuries
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Morpho was the first lending platform to support it. Aave V3 has incentives
stablecoins.keyFact: Issued by Paxos Trust (regulated NY trust) for PayPal. Monthly attestations. Also used for AI infra financing.

stablecoins.name: FRAX
stablecoins.backing: Originally algorithmic + USDC. Now mostly USDC-backed
stablecoins.backingShort: mostly USDC-backed (was algorithmic, pivoted after Terra collapse)
stablecoins.yield: Via sFRAX — from DeFi + RWA (Treasury) yield
stablecoins.yieldSource: DeFi protocol revenue + Treasury yields
stablecoins.curatorUsage: sFRAX used as collateral in DeFi lending markets
stablecoins.keyFact: Pivoted from algorithmic model to USDC-backed after Terra/UST collapse. frxETH was first collateral for crvUSD.

stablecoins.name: crvUSD
stablecoins.backing: ETH, wBTC, wstETH, sfrxETH, tBTC with LLAMMA soft liquidation
stablecoins.backingShort: overcollateralized crypto with soft liquidation mechanism
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Used in DeFi yield strategies. Rings Protocol scUSD farms crvUSD positions
stablecoins.keyFact: Uses LLAMMA for 'soft liquidation' — positions gradually convert to stablecoin instead of hard liquidating. Peg Keepers stabilize against USDC/USDT.

stablecoins.name: LUSD
stablecoins.backing: ETH only at 110%+ collateral ratio. Fully immutable contracts
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH only (110%+ collateral, immutable, no governance)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Niche — respected for max decentralization but small liquidity limits curator adoption
stablecoins.keyFact: Most decentralized stablecoin. No governance, no admin keys, immutable smart contracts. Only ETH collateral.
stablecoins.regulation: Immutable — no governance or admin of any kind

stablecoins.name: USR
stablecoins.backing: ETH collateral + short futures hedging
stablecoins.backingShort: delta-neutral ETH position (same model as USDe)
stablecoins.yieldSource: funding rates from perpetual futures
stablecoins.curatorUsage: In Morpho vaults (~32% allocation in some). Also on Fluid and Euler
stablecoins.keyFact: Same delta-neutral model as Ethena's USDe but smaller/newer. Raised $10M seed from Coinbase Ventures, Maven11.

stablecoins.name: USDf
stablecoins.backing: Minted from USDC, USDT, FDUSD, BTC, ETH, and altcoins
stablecoins.backingShort: overcollateralized by stablecoins, BTC, ETH, and altcoins
stablecoins.yield: Via sUSDf (staked version). PT-sUSDf via Pendle on Morpho
stablecoins.yieldSource: overcollateralized lending yields
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Re7 curates PT-sUSDf vaults on Morpho
stablecoins.keyFact: Incubated by DWF Labs (controversial market maker). FF Foundation controls all token supply.

stablecoins.name: FDUSD
stablecoins.backing: Cash + Treasuries
stablecoins.backingShort: cash and Treasuries (Hong Kong issuer)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Primarily Binance ecosystem. Not widely used in Morpho curator vaults
stablecoins.keyFact: Had a depeg scare in 2025 — reserve rumors drained liquidity and sparked panic withdrawals.

stablecoins.name: scUSD
stablecoins.backing: USDC deposited into Veda BoringVaults on Ethereum mainnet
stablecoins.backingShort: USDC in Veda vaults farming Aave/Morpho/Convex
stablecoins.yieldSource: DeFi yield farming across Aave, Morpho, Convex
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Sonic-native. Mithras had $2.3M exposure during Stream Finance crisis
stablecoins.keyFact: Multi-layer risk: Rings Protocol + Veda vaults + underlying DeFi protocols + cross-chain (Sonic + Ethereum).

stablecoins.name: xUSD
stablecoins.backing: WAS: Leveraged yield farming across 50+ pools. Recursive self-collateral
stablecoins.backingShort: leveraged yield farming with recursive self-collateral
stablecoins.yieldSource: leveraged farming (failed)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Was in Re7, MEV Capital, Telos vaults — all got destroyed
stablecoins.keyFact: External fund manager lost $93M. Crashed from $1.00 to $0.26 in 24hrs. Total $285M DeFi exposure.
stablecoins.collapseDetails: External fund manager (Ryan DeMattia) caused $93M loss. Used own token as recursive collateral.

stablecoins.name: deUSD
stablecoins.backing: WAS: stETH/sDAI + ETH short positions. 65% secretly routed through Stream Finance
stablecoins.backingShort: delta-neutral ETH positions, but 65% was secretly in Stream Finance
stablecoins.yieldSource: staking rewards + funding rates (failed)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: K3 Capital hit ($2M impaired). Cascading impact on Gauntlet (paused Compound markets)
stablecoins.keyFact: Elixir lent ~$68M USDC to Stream Finance via Morpho without telling deUSD holders. Depegged to $0.04.
stablecoins.collapseDetails: 65% of backing routed through Stream Finance without disclosure. Elixir unilaterally lent ~$68M to Stream.

stablecoins.name: wstETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH staked across 30+ professional node operators via Lido DAO
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH staked via Lido validators (non-rebasing wrapper of stETH)
stablecoins.yieldSource: Ethereum consensus + execution layer rewards (value accrues in exchange rate)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: THE default ETH collateral. Steakhouse, Block Analitica (94.5% LTV), Re7, Gauntlet all use it. Aave dedicated market at 95% LTV
stablecoins.keyFact: Largest DeFi protocol by TVL (~$27.5B). The 'USDC of ETH collateral.' Exchange rate vs market price oracle debate is ongoing.
stablecoins.depegHistory: stETH traded at 5-7% discount in May-June 2022 during Terra/3AC collapse. Pre-Shapella (no withdrawals possible).

stablecoins.name: cbETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH staked through Coinbase's institutional validator infrastructure
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH staked by Coinbase validators (25% commission)
stablecoins.yieldSource: Ethereum staking rewards minus Coinbase's 25% commission
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Aave V3 collateral. Block Analitica Flagship ETH vault. Institutional preference
stablecoins.keyFact: Centralized but regulated. Coinbase also issues cbBTC — paired institutional collateral set. 198K ETH deposited.

stablecoins.name: rETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH staked across 2,500+ permissionless node operators bonded with 8-16 ETH + RPL
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH staked by 2,500+ permissionless node operators (most decentralized LST)
stablecoins.yieldSource: Ethereum staking rewards from decentralized operator set
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Aave V3 collateral. Block Analitica Flagship ETH vault (rETH/WETH + rETH/USDC). Decentralization-focused curators
stablecoins.keyFact: Most decentralized LST — anyone can run a node with 8 ETH + RPL. Atlas upgrade (2023) reduced bond to 8 ETH.
stablecoins.depegHistory: No major depeg events. Considered highest-integrity LST.

stablecoins.name: sfrxETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH staked via Frax's dual-token model (frxETH + sfrxETH)
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH staked via Frax dual-token model (frxETH holders forfeit yield to sfrxETH)
stablecoins.yieldSource: Ethereum staking rewards concentrated on sfrxETH holders (frxETH holders get none)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: First collateral type for crvUSD. Some Morpho market presence
stablecoins.keyFact: Higher yield than peers because frxETH holders forfeit staking rewards to sfrxETH holders. Dual-token design is unique.

stablecoins.name: osETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH staked via StakeWise V3's self-sovereign vault system
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH staked via StakeWise self-sovereign validator vaults
stablecoins.yieldSource: Ethereum staking rewards
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Re7 WETH vault on Morpho (initial launch asset). MEV Capital WETH vault
stablecoins.keyFact: Users can run their own validators or delegate. Re7's WETH vault launched with osETH as one of its initial assets.

stablecoins.name: weETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH staked + restaked on EigenLayer and Symbiotic AVSs
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH staked via EtherFi + restaked on EigenLayer/Symbiotic (non-custodial)
stablecoins.yieldSource: ETH staking + EigenLayer AVS rewards + ETHFI token incentives
stablecoins.curatorUsage: THE dominant LRT. 57.9% of ALL Aave WETH borrowings ($3.27B debt). Re7, MEV Capital, Gauntlet LRT Core, Block Analitica
stablecoins.keyFact: Largest LRT. $4.59B supply on Aave. 93% LTV eMode enables leverage loops. Non-custodial — stakers keep validator keys.
stablecoins.depegHistory: No major depeg. Relatively clean track record.

stablecoins.name: ezETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH restaked on EigenLayer via Renzo's operator set
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH restaked via EigenLayer (Renzo manages operator/AVS selection)
stablecoins.yieldSource: ETH staking + EigenLayer restaking rewards
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Aave V3 (93% LTV eMode). Gauntlet LRT Core vault (initial asset). Re7 WETH vault
stablecoins.keyFact: Worst LRT depeg — dropped to 0.2 ETH on Uniswap (April 2024). Root cause: NO withdrawal function existed at launch.
stablecoins.depegHistory: April 24, 2024: Dropped to 0.2 ETH (~$688 vs $3,400 NAV). 7%+ depeg triggered by REZ airdrop — no withdrawal function existed.

stablecoins.name: rsETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH restaked via EigenLayer. Multi-LST: accepts stETH, ETHx, sfrxETH
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH restaked via EigenLayer with multi-LST deposits (stETH, ETHx, sfrxETH)
stablecoins.yieldSource: ETH staking + EigenLayer AVS rewards
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Aave V3 (93% LTV eMode, added May 2024). Morpho markets. Fluid and Euler
stablecoins.keyFact: 2nd largest LRT (~$2B TVL). Multi-LST means it carries risk of its weakest underlying LST. Backed by Stader Labs.

stablecoins.name: pufETH
stablecoins.backing: ETH restaked on EigenLayer with Secure-Signer anti-slashing tech (SGX-based)
stablecoins.backingShort: ETH restaked via EigenLayer with hardware anti-slashing (Secure-Signer SGX)
stablecoins.yieldSource: ETH staking + EigenLayer rewards
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Morpho markets. Smaller scale vs weETH/ezETH
stablecoins.keyFact: Anti-slashing via SGX Secure-Signer is novel. Had -5.46% depeg Aug 2024. Instant exit costs 1% fee, standard takes 14+ days.
stablecoins.depegHistory: Aug 5, 2024: -5.46% max depeg. Ongoing small depeg from withdrawal friction.

stablecoins.name: WBTC
stablecoins.backing: 1:1 BTC in custody by BitGo (transferred 2/3 keys to BiT Global/Justin Sun JV)
stablecoins.backingShort: 1:1 BTC in custodial reserves (custody transferred to Justin Sun-linked BiT Global)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Dominant BTC collateral across Aave, Morpho, Compound, Euler. Used in crvUSD minting. All major curators
stablecoins.keyFact: 43% market share (125K BTC). BitGo transferred custody keys to Justin Sun-linked BiT Global. Coinbase delisted WBTC Dec 2024.
stablecoins.regulation: BitGo (regulated custodian, custody transfer raised concerns)
stablecoins.depegHistory: No price depeg but custody controversy Aug 2024 caused trust crisis.

stablecoins.name: cbBTC
stablecoins.backing: 1:1 BTC held in Coinbase custody
stablecoins.backingShort: 1:1 BTC in Coinbase custody (regulated US entity)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Growing fast on Aave V3 and Morpho. Institutional migration from WBTC
stablecoins.keyFact: Launched Sept 2024. 25% market share (73K BTC, ~$6.5B). No proof of reserves published. Paired with cbETH.

stablecoins.name: LBTC
stablecoins.backing: BTC staked via Babylon protocol (Bitcoin-native PoS staking)
stablecoins.backingShort: BTC staked on Babylon protocol (first native BTC staking yield)
stablecoins.yieldSource: Babylon protocol staking rewards + protocol incentives
stablecoins.curatorUsage: $352M on Aave (84% LTV). Gauntlet and Re7 curate Morpho vaults. 70+ DeFi integrations
stablecoins.keyFact: Fastest-growing BTC LST. 4th largest BTC derivative. Reached $1B TVL in 92 days. Cross-chain via Chainlink CCIP.

stablecoins.name: tBTC
stablecoins.backing: BTC held by decentralized threshold signature scheme (100+ signers, no single custodian)
stablecoins.backingShort: BTC in decentralized threshold custody (100+ signers, no single custodian)
stablecoins.curatorUsage: Morpho collateral. Used in crvUSD minting. Most decentralized BTC wrapper
stablecoins.keyFact: Most decentralized BTC wrapper. 5,942 BTC. 800% growth since 2024. No single custodian can steal funds.

curators.name: Steakhouse Financial
curators.keyFact: Guardian drill system for emergency response. Conservative collateral kept them safe during Stream crisis. ~$1.28B TVL.

curators.name: Gauntlet
curators.collateralPreference: Moderate — accepts LRTs with quantitative guardrails
curators.streamExposure: Indirect — paused Compound markets after deUSD cascade
curators.keyFact: Left Aave risk management (2024) to become Morpho curator. LRT Core vault hit by ezETH depeg. Absorbed $775M USDT during Stream.

curators.name: Re7 Capital
curators.collateralPreference: Aggressive — weETH, osETH, USD1, PT tokens, accepted xUSD
curators.streamExposure: $27.4M — $14.65M in xUSD segregated vault on Euler
curators.keyFact: Most active curator (was 14 chains, 100+ pools). 83% TVL collapse post-Stream. Bought Giza automation ($500K). 5-7x more revenue per $1M than Gauntlet.

curators.name: Block Analitica
curators.collateralPreference: Conservative — wstETH, rETH, cbETH. Led oracle debate
curators.keyFact: Led the wstETH oracle debate — argued exchange rate is the 'real price.' Flagship vaults focus on battle-tested collateral only.

curators.name: MEV Capital
curators.collateralPreference: Aggressive — LRTs, exotic collateral, accepted xUSD
curators.keyFact: $10M+ bad debt. 80% AUM collapse. Absorbed by Belem Capital. Most consistent active APY outperformer before collapse.

curators.name: K3 Capital
keyVaults: USDT vault for Pendle LP/PT collateral
curators.collateralPreference: Moderate — Pendle PTs, avoided xUSD but hit by deUSD
curators.streamExposure: $2M impaired via deUSD (pursuing legal action against Elixir)
curators.keyFact: Avoided xUSD but hit by deUSD's hidden Stream exposure. Dedicated Pendle collateral vault on Morpho. Legal action against Elixir.

curators.name: Tulipa Capital
curators.keyFact: One of the 'winners' who stuck to safe collateral during Stream crisis.

questionBank.text: On which chain is scUSD's underlying USDC farmed?

questionBank.text: FDUSD is deployed on which chains?

questionBank.explanation: USDM is a rebasing ERC-20 — your balance increases daily. Others use wrapper appreciation.

questionBank.text: Which stablecoin earns yield from US Treasury bills via Ondo Finance?
questionBank.explanation: USDY earns ~4.25% APY from short-term Treasuries managed by Ondo.

questionBank.correct: Slashing — staked amount can be cut during protocol deficit
questionBank.explanation: stkGHO is in Aave's Umbrella safety module — stakers face slashing risk.

questionBank.text: During bear markets, what can happen to sUSDe yield?
questionBank.correct: It can go negative (protocol loses money on funding rates)
questionBank.explanation: When funding rates turn negative in bear markets, Ethena's insurance fund covers losses — but it's finite.

questionBank.text: How does USDY generate its ~4.25% yield?
questionBank.correct: From underlying short-term Treasury and bank deposit returns
questionBank.explanation: USDY is backed by Treasuries and bank deposits — the yield is simply the Treasury return.

questionBank.text: What is the approximate yield range for sUSDe in favorable (bull) markets?
questionBank.explanation: sUSDe can reach 15-25% when funding rates are high in bull markets.

questionBank.text: sFRAX earns yield from what sources?
questionBank.explanation: sFRAX yield combines DeFi revenue and Treasury yields via FinresPBC.

questionBank.explanation: Coinbase co-created USDC with Circle via the Centre Consortium.

questionBank.text: Who manages the USDC reserve investment fund?
questionBank.explanation: BlackRock manages the Circle Reserve Fund (USDC reserves).

questionBank.text: What role does BNY Mellon play for USDC?
questionBank.explanation: BNY Mellon provides custody services for USDC reserves alongside BlackRock's management.

questionBank.text: Which firm provides attestations for USDC — Deloitte or BDO?
questionBank.explanation: Deloitte provides monthly attestations for USDC. BDO Italia does USDT's quarterly attestations.

questionBank.text: What is the frequency of USDC reserve attestations?
questionBank.explanation: USDC has monthly reserve attestations by Deloitte.

questionBank.text: What is the frequency of USDT reserve attestations?
questionBank.explanation: USDT has quarterly attestations by BDO Italia — notably NOT full audits.

questionBank.explanation: Ankura Trust is the collateral agent — they liquidate assets to repay USDY holders if Ondo defaults.

questionBank.text: Which investment firm manages USD1's reserve assets?
questionBank.explanation: Fidelity manages USD1's reserve portfolio. BitGo provides custody.

questionBank.explanation: Anchorage Digital acquired Mountain Protocol in May 2025.

questionBank.text: FinresPBC is associated with which stablecoin?
